overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair's December 8 email only memorialized the discussion from the posted December 7 meeting, so it was not deliberation outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly deliberated outside a posted meeting via a December 8 email to the interim administrator, copying all members, after a December 7 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that Chair Neville’s December 8 email did not constitute deliberation outside of a properly posted meeting and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
